name: What should I prepare before an initial consultation for a luxury bathroom renovation?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before an initial consultation for a luxury bathroom renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before an initial consultation for a luxury bathroom renovation, it's beneficial to gather any inspiration photos, an idea of your desired functionalities (e.g., walk-in shower, freestanding tub, heated floors), and a general understanding of your current bathroom's challenges. Considering your daily routines and how you envision using the space will help us tailor a spa-inspired retreat that aligns perfectly with your vision and enhances your homeowner experience.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before a luxury bathroom renovation consultation, gather inspiration photos, list desired functionalities, and consider your current bathroom's challenges to help us create your ideal spa-inspired space.
